derivation: Per-node status at the no-op, which is base-revision source under the TARGET test tree, keyed in the same path form sets.json uses. The scorer consults this so a node absent from a run counts as regressed only when the no-op recorded it passing. Collected counts are the two graded endpoints; the floor is lower because five test modules cannot be imported at the base revision and none of their nodes are collected there. The collected counts are measured under the EXACT verifier invocation, which --ignores both the optional-dependency printer module and the excluded mathml printer module; an earlier revision counted them from a host run that ignored only the first, baking a floor 110 nodes too high, and the node-count guard correctly refused the oracle as a result.
